gaps.criterion: [inferred] Given a completed Researcher run, when the resulting ResearchBrief is inspected, then it has non-empty topic title, rationale, 3-5 key facts, at least one source link, and an exercise idea
gaps.evidence: 10 of the 15 entries in daily_workshop/seed_topics.json (across agentic_ai, cloud_computing, and quantum_computing) have "source_links": []. Researcher._select_from_seed_backlog (daily_workshop/researcher.py) reads `entry.get('source_links', ())` verbatim with no fallback, and Researcher._normalize_key_facts only clamps key_facts — it never inspects or backfills source_links. Any ResearchBrief built from one of those 10 seed entries has an empty source_links tuple, which fires on Researcher's own bundled fallback data (the exact path REQ-005 exercises whenever live research is unavailable).
suggested_fix_directions: Populate the 10 empty "source_links" arrays in daily_workshop/seed_topics.json with at least one real, relevant documentation/reference URL per entry (preferred — keeps ResearchBrief content honest and useful, matches the pattern already used by the other 5 entries that do have a link).

AND/OR add an explicit, logged fallback in Researcher (e.g. in _select_from_seed_backlog or _normalize_key_facts) so that a seed entry with empty source_links still produces a ResearchBrief with a non-empty source_links tuple (e.g. a generic 'search the web for: {title}' pointer) rather than silently propagating an empty tuple — do not fabricate a fake-looking specific URL as a blanket default.
Add a unit test in researcher.py's suite covering the specific case of a seed backlog entry with empty source_links, so this class of gap cannot regress silently.
